name: Lolicon Kyoushi no Oshiego Ryoujoku Keikaku
original_name: ロリコン教師の教え子凌辱計画
source:
Kuroi-sensei of the S-district has his eye on a certain student.
It's been 6 months since he started teaching at the school and has earned
the trust of the pupils. But there is another face to this man...
Kuroi is a deplorable lolicon with r*pe fantasies.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ104679.html]DLsite English[/url]]

他来这所学校任教已满6个月，深得学生们的信任。
然而，这个男人还有不为人知的另一面……
